title: Seeking the Unfamiliar but Memorable: Conceptual Creativity as Meta-Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.16477v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: What does it mean to create a new concept, rather than retrieve a familiar one? Repeatedly sampling a generative model at the same prompt produces variations with similar styles and typical content. We propose that creativity is the production of stimuli that are unfamiliar to an adaptive observer at first sight, but quickly learnable from a few exposures. We formalize this as a Creator-Appraiser pair: a Creator generates a candidate, an Appraiser adapts to it for a few inner-loop learning steps, and the Appraiser's improvement becomes the reward the Creator optimizes through. We instantiate the framework with diffusion as the Creator, an autoencoder Appraiser on MNIST, and a CLIP Appraiser with a low-rank adapter for natural images. translated_title: 寻求陌生却令人难忘之物：作为元学习的概念创造性
translated_abstract: 创造一个新概念，而非检索一个熟悉的概念，究竟意味着什么？在同一提示词下反复采样生成模型，会产生风格相似、内容典型的变体。我们提出，创造性是指产生这样一种刺激：对于自适应的观察者而言，第一眼看上去是陌生的，但经过几次接触便能快速学会。我们将其形式化为“创造者-鉴赏者”（Creator-Appraiser）配对机制：创造者生成候选样本，鉴赏者通过若干内循环学习步骤对其进行适应，而鉴赏者的学习提升则成为创造者所优化的奖励。我们以扩散模型作为创造者来实例化该框架，在MNIST上使用自编码器作为鉴赏者，对自然图像则使用带低秩适配器的CLIP作为鉴赏者。在扩散模型被冻结且无需额外语言条件的情况下，仅凭元学习梯度就足以产生超越基础模型生成能力的风格变化和概念组合。
tldr: 该论文提出将创造性形式化为“创造者-鉴赏者”元学习框架——创造者生成初看陌生但几次接触即可快速学会的刺激，以鉴赏者快速适应的提升作为奖励信号，从而在冻结扩散模型、无需额外语言条件的情况下，生成超越基础模型能力的风格变化与概念组合。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes conceptual creativity as a Creator-Appraiser meta-learning framework, where the Creator generates stimuli that appear unfamiliar at first sight but are quickly learnable from a few exposures, and the Appraiser's fast adaptation improvement serves as the reward, enabling a frozen diffusion model to produce novel stylistic variations and concept compositions beyond its base capabilities.
